summary: Kayaker seen capsizing on North Lake west of Trinidad and never resurfacing; multi-day search, body located by underwater drone and dive team, turned over to coroner April 8
location: North Lake, west of Trinidad (Hwy 12, ~8,500 ft)
responding_agency: Colorado Parks and Wildlife Marine Evidence Recovery Team; Las Animas County Sheriff's Office; Stonewall Fire Department
notes: Parent-opened run 659. Witnesses saw the capsize Monday ~11 a.m.; body found Wednesday at 3 p.m. by CPW underwater drone (sonar, lights, camera) plus dive team; coroner ID pending per article. DroneXL cites Out There Colorado reporting.
